name: @tangen/studio-runtime
description: The framework-neutral Tangen Studio runtime - the visual-edit overlay and the admin/site message protocol. No framework dependency, so a React, Vue or Astro site can all support click-in-preview.

scripts.build: bun build ./src/index.ts ./src/interactions-tier2.ts --outdir dist --target browser --format esm --splitting --packages external && tsc --emitDeclarationOnly -p tsconfig.build.json
